title: EntreprenAIs Establishes Proprietary Technology to Run Agent Skills on CPU Only
summary: Many skills — including Daily Briefing and End of Day — now run on an ultra-lightweight local LLM. A chat room assistant that handles routine tasks via local LLM is also live.

title: Two New Features Added to Chat Room — C-Suite Visualization & IoA Guest Invitation

title: EntreprenAIs Now Available
